title: One Minute Back
rule: The station clock refunds one minute for an unfinished goodbye.
planted_clue: Only the clock at the empty platform turns back.
payoff: After the child waves goodbye to their mother, the clock can go forward.
beats: The last train took my mother. The station clock kept one minute.
Every night, at nine, its hands slipped back.
Tonight I stayed. Someone in a blue coat was waiting.
Mum. Last time I was too angry to wave.
This time, I raised my hand.
At nine oh one, the platform was empty.
